items.issue: Mechanics field contains Rain of Arrows mechanics followed by unrelated Blood Weapons material.
items.required_action: recover exact source boundaries; preserve both source segments with provenance; do not guess or delete content

items.issue: Record_ID namespace is reused across files; 1,256 duplicated values affect 2,512 rows.
items.required_action: use source-qualified keys immediately; assign governed global stable IDs with deterministic alias/migration evidence before cross-file canonicalization

items.target: consequential active/passive Ability rows with missing action/frequency/resource semantics

manual multidimensional review; apply CAB-07 anti-recursion and CAB-08 interaction defaults; determine missing delivery limits before final price

items.target: records whose stacking/synergy group materially affects outcome
items.required_action: assign mechanical interaction group or explicit authored exception; do not infer from source family/tree
normalize toward stable Ability/node IDs and typed predicates; detect self-dependency, cycles and missing references without inventing prerequisites

items.target: records whose grant/purchase/creation/training/exposure/membership/etc. mode is not source-governed

items.target: records proven to be direct XP purchases

items.required_action: retain source price as provenance; assign CAB calibrated direct price using effect burden and high-risk review; do not price headers/listings/grants as purchases

items.target: ordinary progressions with legacy tier-unlock schedules
items.required_action: map to CAB ordinary access anchors unless explicit special progression authority applies; preserve legacy price provenance

items.issue: Observed T1 and T3 members with no T2 in bounded source.
items.required_action: recover source intent; never invent Tier-2 filler

items.issue: Observed start at T2 without existing explicit special-start authority.
items.required_action: verify whether T1 is source-missing, intentionally absent or represented elsewhere; do not invent T1

items.target: 42 rows sharing Ability_Name + Ability_Tree + Tier tuples
items.required_action: determine legitimate repetition/listing/upgrade/reconciliation versus duplicate identity; no automatic dedupe
separate automatic biology grants, Species-qualified selections, creation-only options, learned/cultural/mystical/technical content and non-Species Elementalist rows using PPIA-05/CAB-09 authority
rerun CAB-14/15/21 benchmarks after material repricing batches and preserve RAV/dependency separation

project final CAB rules into player/GM/reference surfaces without collapsing distinctions among tier, price, acquisition, prerequisite, RAV, timing and balance dimensions

completion_definition: A repair item closes only with source/governed evidence, stable identity, before/after provenance, required semantic fields, explicit CAB price/access treatment where applicable, and migration handling where live Characters could be affected.
